context: A quarterly review confronts mounting losses
purpose: Review the quarter; teach 赤字/市内/外部/ミス/再度/づくり/お尋ね/自覚

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期、また赤字になりそうだ。
lines.en: This quarter looks set to be in the red again.
lines.style: grim boss facing the unwelcome numbers

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市内の店舗が特に苦戦しています。
lines.en: The in-city stores are struggling especially.
lines.style: candid assistant delivering the hard data

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 外部のコンサルにも相談すべきか。
lines.en: Should we consult an outside firm too?
lines.style: deliberating boss weighing his options, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発注のミスも重なってしまって。
lines.en: Ordering mistakes piled up as well.
lines.style: apologetic assistant owning a process failure

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Let us review the costs once more.
lines.style: determined boss pushing for a fresh look

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 信頼づくりから立て直したいですね。
lines.en: I want to rebuild starting from trust-building.
lines.style: principled assistant proposing a foundation, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一つお尋ねしたいんだが、人員は足りてる？
lines.en: Let me ask one thing — are we staffed enough?
lines.style: probing boss checking a practical concern

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ぎりぎりです。私たちも危機感の自覚が必要です。
lines.en: Barely. We need awareness of the crisis too.
lines.style: sober assistant urging shared accountability, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
